sql: SELECT r.year,r.round,re.driver_id,d.forename,d.surname,COUNT(*) rows,COUNT(DISTINCT constructor_id) teams FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959 AND r.round=(SELECT MAX(round) FROM races rr JOIN results z USING(race_id) WHERE rr.year=r.year AND z.driver_id=re.driver_id) GROUP BY r.year,r.round,re.driver_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY re.driver_id,r.year
